assessment: Rapan et al. report a new multi-modal parcellation of the macaque frontal cortex based on cytoarchitectural division complemented with functional connectivity and neurochemical data. This builds on prior highly influential maps that subdivide the cortex based on anatomical fingerprints, both confirming these prior reports and defining new subdivisions. As such, this is a fundamental contribution with compelling results that can guide future neuroscientific research into the function of the frontal lobes.
